format: JSON Lines — one self-contained JSON object per line, append-only. Never rewrite or delete a row; supersede it with a new row and set the old row's verdict to SUPERSEDED.
purpose: Records the TRUE number of configurations ever tried, so that Deflated Sharpe Ratio and Probability of Backtest Overfitting can be computed honestly. A registry that only contains successes makes deflation meaningless — failures and abandoned runs are the whole point.

field_notes.logged_at: YYYY-MM-DD the row was written (may be much later than the run for backfilled rows).
field_notes.backfilled: true if reconstructed after the fact from an artifact rather than logged by the run itself. Backfilled rows are incomplete by construction.
field_notes.family: Grouping key for multiplicity. Trials in the same family are testing the same underlying hypothesis and their configs_tried should be SUMMED when deflating.
field_notes.configs_tried: Object, not a bare integer. { declared_grid: int, uncertain: bool, note: string }. If the true count is unknown, set uncertain=true and say why — an honest lower bound beats a confident wrong number.
field_notes.selection_metric: What was optimised or what the acceptance rule was. Pre-registered rules should be quoted verbatim.
field_notes.headline: Free-form object of the measured numbers. Prefer NET of costs; if gross, say so in the field name.
field_notes.verdict: One of the enum below. Never 'validated' — nothing is validated.
field_notes.shipped: Did this change production behaviour? Most rows should be false.
field_notes.source: Array of repo paths backing every number in the row. A row with no source is not evidence.

known_limitations: BACKFILL IS INCOMPLETE. Rows T-0001..T-0009 were reconstructed on 2026-08-15 from workspace/optimization-runs/ and reviews/. Configurations tried informally, in abandoned sessions, or in ad-hoc scripts are NOT represented. The true trial count is strictly higher than what this file shows.
Therefore any Deflated Sharpe or PBO computed from this registry today is OPTIMISTIC — it under-corrects for multiplicity. State that caveat wherever such a number is reported.
Nothing appends to this file automatically yet. Until the experiment harness writes its own rows, the registry decays the moment someone forgets. Tracked as Q-081.

The universe is NOT survivorship-free (56 present-day large-cap survivors, hard-coded). Every win rate, return, and Sharpe in this file is inflated by an unmeasured amount. scripts/optimize-grid.ts documents this in-line.

usage.before_reporting_any_result: Sum configs_tried across every row in the same family, add the configurations tried in the current session, and deflate using that total.
usage.on_every_experiment: Append a row — including failures, including runs you abandoned halfway. This is enforced by .claude/commands/handoff.md step 5.
